official_documentation_checked.finding: The listed standard library components do not define a ZIP archive reader or entry API.
std::ifstream reads bytes from files; it does not interpret ZIP entries or decompress their contents.

limit: Scoped to the ISO C++ standard library. Platform archive frameworks and third-party C libraries usable from C++ are inventoried separately. No standard ZIP-aware API was documented to run.
